data.turoyo: w krayzi suġlo suġlo, ksaymənne mašṭuḥo, yaʕni sə ḥḏoḏe, kowən šṭiḥe sə ḥḏoḏe aʕ ʕənwe.
data.translation: Dann legen sie die Trauben in Reihen hin, sie machen einen mašṭuḥo, d.h. die Trauben werden nebeneinander hingelegt.

rationale: New Detransitive Part. Pass. box; resulting arrangement after laying out grapes.

summary: The sequence first describes laying the grapes in rows, then kowən šṭiḥe describes their resulting arrangement. That context supports Detransitive Part. Pass.; plural -e by itself does not distinguish every finite or adjectival use.
No external agent appears in the result clause, while the preceding generic workers supply the causal context. The reading does not imply a separate technical grape-processing sense.
mašṭuḥo is an adjacent noun in the same verse; it is not counted as a second šṭḥ verbal occurrence or used to invent a finite base form.
Verify the plural šṭiḥe paradigm against finite Detransitive Preterit forms; the Part. Pass. classification is based on the local copular result-state construction.
Grapes as plural inanimate subject are spread beside one another; this extends the inherited human stretching example without a new numbered sense.
